definitions.explanation: A written account of a journey, describing places visited, experiences had, and impressions formed during travel.

examples.japanese: {旅行記|りょこうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧{旅行記|りょこうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ブログ→ブログ：05104_burogu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Her European travelogue is popular on her blog.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{旅行記|りょこうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Reading travelogues by Meiji-era writers gives a good picture of what Japan was like at the time.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (travel) and {記|き} (record/account). Can refer to anything from a casual blog post about a trip to a published literary work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅行記|りょこうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a travelogue
- {旅行記|りょこうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read a travelogue
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{旅行記|りょこうき}: overseas travel journal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紀行文|きこうぶん}→紀行文：22669_kikoubun⟧: travel essay — more literary; implies a polished piece of writing rather than a personal record
- ⟦{旅日記|たびにっき}→旅日記：22691_tabinikki⟧: travel diary — more personal and day-by-day in format
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦ブログ→ブログ：05104_burogu⟧: travel blog — the modern, casual equivalent
